description: GitHub account card in Settings > Repository, plus an opt-in human device-flow sign-in.

setup.name: Create fixture that starts in Settings > Repository

tests.name: device flow connects a GitHub account
tests.description: Needs CUTREADY_GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID (env or .env). The gate continues once the card shows a connected account.

gate.name: Connect GitHub
gate.instructions: In CutReady, Settings > Repository > GitHub account: Disconnect first if already connected, click Connect GitHub, approve the device code in the browser, and continue once the card says "Connected as <user>".

choices.label: GitHub OAuth is not configured here
